name: Joseph
source: A bottomless pit of knowledge, he is a master of his subject and many others, if there was enough time Joseph could probably teach every class. Although very polite and considerate, he's not very fond of being social with his students, teaching is his job and he likes doing so undisturbed. His grizzled look does entire the hearts of many from time to time.
